{
  "participants": [

      "login": "vicjuma",
      "stance": "objection",
      "note": "objected to defaulting -walletrebroadcast to false over user convenience concerns"
    },
    {
      "login": "w0xlt",
      "stance": "question",
      "note": "asked whether rebroadcasting can safely be disabled and suggested extending -walletbroadcast"
    }
  ],
  "claims": [
    {
      "id": "c:5896604099",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "question",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "Can wallet rebroadcasting safely be disabled, and if so, why is rebroadcasting needed at all?",
      "quote": "Can we safely disable wallet re-broadcasting? If so, why do we need re-broadcasting at all?",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author explains why rebroadcasting is useful and why disabling it can be safe",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:5906908312"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "c:5906908312",
      "status_by_quote": "I think yes. Most users don't need it, but are nevertheless exposed to the privacy leaks it brings even if they never use it."
    },
    {
      "id": "c:5896604099",
      "part": 2,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "interface",
      "text": "Extend -walletbroadcast with new modes instead of introducing another parameter with a very similar name",
      "quote": "extending `-walletbroadcast` with new modes would be cleaner than introducing another parameter with a very similar name.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author agrees it is worth considering and proposes potential modes",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:5906908312"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "c:5906908312",
      "status_by_quote": "Hmm, sounds like something worth considering. Currently `-walletbroadcast` is a boolean. What would you suggest?"
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:4135840655",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "interface",
      "text": "Defaulting -walletrebroadcast to false harms convenience for users who expect rebroadcasts without extra setup",
      "quote": "IMO, I think rebroadcasting outweighs privacy so defaulting to true would be convenient.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author explains reasoning but notes willingness to default to on",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:4142146539"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "rc:4142146539",
      "status_by_quote": "I am fine with a default to \"on\" (as in `master` without this PR)."
    }
  ],
  "support": [],
  "waiting_on": [
    {
      "on": "reviewer",
      "what": "response from w0xlt on suggested modes for -walletbroadcast",
      "id": "c:5906908312"
    },
    {
      "on": "reviewer",

    }
  ],
  "notes": "The author answered both parts of w0xlt's comment (explaining the rationale for rebroadcast and asking for thoughts on -walletbroadcast modes) and replied to vicjuma's objection regarding the default setting."
}
